text: dsh-approval-reminder 是 DSH Web 待处理事项提醒插件。会话需要权限批准、回答问题或审阅计划时，网页显示提醒卡，Windows 通过 PowerShell/WinForms 弹出桌面气泡；点击气泡可打开对应会话，事项处理完后会清除通知。适合同时运行多个会话、希望及时处理请求的用户。需要 Windows、PowerShell/WinForms 与 DSH Web GUI。

dsh-approval-reminder alerts DSH Web users when a session needs approval, an answer, or plan review. It shows a page card and a Windows desktop bubble. Clicking the bubble opens that session; resolving all items clears the reminder. Requires Windows and DSH Web GUI.

能不能点一下系统气泡就跳到需要我处理的会话？
How can I keep track of DSH questions waiting for my answer across sessions?
dsh-approval-reminder 的功能「网页待处理卡片」：在 DSH Web overlay 展示待批准或待回答的会话；新事项会触发桌面通知，用户可从卡片打开对应会话，事项清空后通知也会清除。
dsh-approval-reminder 的功能「Windows 桌面气泡」：收到网页提交的待处理项目后，按队列显示 PowerShell/WinForms 通知。点击气泡可打开对应会话，全部事项处理后可清除通知。

@dsh-external/dsh-approval-reminder README · dsh-approval-reminder：Persistent **approval / question reminder** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI.

Whenever any session lands a permission request (approval) or a question that needs you to click, a **persistent bottom-right system bubble** appears (click it to jump to that conversation), plus an in-page reminder card. The bubble does not steal focus and stays until resolved — you will never silently wait on a stalled waterfall again.

@dsh-external/dsh-approval-reminder README · How it works：- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — two loopback-only routes under `/api/dsh-approval-reminder/*`; renders the toast with a hidden PowerShell/WinForms process (borderless, rounded, topmost, click-to-close, never activates).
- **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`) — subscribes to the authoritative per-session `useSessionPendingInteraction` hook (`uiSession.pendingInteractions` registry); on a NEW pending key it POSTs `/notify`, when everything is resolved it POSTs `/notify { clear: true }`; bubble clicks are drained through `/poll-open` and the page navigates to the conversation that needs attention. A small self-test badge (bottom-left) mirrors the pending registry for liveness.
@dsh-external/dsh-approval-reminder README · How it works：CJK is lossless: bubble text travels through environment variables, no base64/EncodedCommand.

@dsh-external/dsh-approval-reminder README · Install：DSH loads this plugin as a profile bundle (see `cordis.patch.yml`). Easiest:

1. Put this repo under your DSH `plugin-src/local/` (or any path your host loads plugins from).
2. Ensure the profile bundle row is applied:
   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-approval-reminder
         name: '@dsh-external/dsh-approval-reminder'
   ```
3. Restart `dsh web`. The reminder is persistent across sessions — no per-session `cordis_define` needed.

@dsh-external/dsh-approval-reminder README · Requirements：- Windows (bubble uses PowerShell + WinForms)
- DeepSeek Harness host + Web GUI
